summary: Decent Holding Inc., a PRC-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on November 5, 2026 its board adopted the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, authorizing an initial pool of 200,000 Class A ordinary shares for options, SARs, restricted shares, RSUs and performance awards to directors, officers, employees and consultants. No price, premium, stake or transaction terms are stated; the plan is administered by a committee with standard cause and affiliate definitions. This is a routine compensation/equity-plan adoption, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
